blockers.title: Production composition uses InMemory product repositories
must_prove: Desktop and Service production composition construct durable DB-backed repositories
process restart preserves exact product reads/mutations
no production composition import or construction of InMemory product repositories

blockers.title: Formal Job API is M0 skeleton and worker does not execute domain work
must_prove: Application Job API is backed by DurableJobControl
governed worker commands execute domain pipeline work
durable state reaches QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED or fail-closed terminal states

blockers.title: Production runtime requires synthetic qualification fixtures
must_prove: production adapters exist for governed source families or explicitly report unsupported adapters
qualification source data is production-format and outside test fixture package

blockers.title: Full-product E2E aggregates component evidence rather than one installed production chain
must_prove: one installed-package scenario crosses import, worker, canonical, world, metric, release, DB/object persistence, P1-P6 API and restart/replay
SQLite Desktop and PostgreSQL Service both execute the chain

high_priority: Runtime feature availability derives from configured and live dependencies rather than admitted=true defaults.
Service identity provider is configurable and least-privilege; one all-powerful bearer token is not the production identity model.
Security audit sink is persistent in formal Desktop and Service composition.
Backup/restore is production-qualified for Desktop SQLite/object store and Service PostgreSQL/object store.
Desktop exact-ID governance is preserved while discovery removes manual UUID/JSON operator workflows.
Final qualification is represented by detached attestation bound to immutable package SHA256 values.
Runtime qualification reports final product qualification, not only B3 data/compute qualification.
